**** DEREK DORGAN AUCTIONEER BALLINCOLLIG (021)4871777 (086)0483003 ****

Situated in an exceptional location, this beautifully presented three bedroom property has an added benefit of a large front and side       garden, which will offer great potential for future expansion (Subject to planning).
The location cannot be overstated, due to its close proximity to Ballincollig Town, The Model Farm Road, Cork City, CUH, UCC Etc.

This property would be an ideal first buyer home, people wishing to right size or as an investment property as it offers great potential for so many reasons and is fair to say that this is truly a once off opportunity.

Accommodation consists of : Lounge, Bedroom, Kitchen/Dining Room and main bathroom on the ground floor with two bedrooms on the first floor.
